scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const file of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { fs.rmSync(file); } catch {} } const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; const execPath=process.env.npm_execpath || ''; const isPnpm=ua.startsWith('pnpm/') || /pnpm/i.test(execPath); if (ua && !isPnpm) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
